messages.subject: why did reactive event not render Text properly
parts:
Hi everbody, I've encounter a shiny problem about reactive event.
After uploading file, I call importFile() function(call many other user defined function and spend about 10 minutes) in common.r to read file and validate data,
and return statusText to render, but it won't refresh latest result in renderText()

my partly code as belowing~

source("fakepath/common.r", 
       encoding = "UTF-8")

server <- function(input, output) {
  fileUpload <- reactive({   
    input$fileInput
  })

  output$uploadStatus <- renderText({
    if (is.null(input$fileInput))
      return (NULL)
    importFile(input$fileInput)
  })
}
